question: Should OpenClaw adopt the proposed Claws model as the experimental, shared OpenClaw/ClawHub contract for adding one complete agent package per job?
rationale: The patch is a coherent RFC rather than a mechanical correction, but it introduces a new CLI, manifest format, lifecycle contract, and cross-repository ownership model that cannot be accepted solely from document consistency.

options.title: Sponsor the experimental contract
options.body: Accept the RFC with the existing experimental gates and require a later explicit decision before compatibility guarantees or graduation.

options.title: Pause pending product charter
options.body: Keep the RFC open until maintainers settle whether this agent-package lifecycle belongs in the core product roadmap and who owns the cross-repository contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the experimental contract
recommendation.body: Accept the RFC with the existing experimental gates and require a later explicit decision before compatibility guarantees or graduation.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review supplied the central agent-centric ownership model now reflected in the RFC, so they are the best evidenced routing candidate for the product decision.
